selected.matrix_type: FPKM (Cufflinks; gene-level sum of RefSeq isoform FPKM)

decisions.reason: Deposited file is Cufflinks isoform FPKM (data_processing: 'FPKM were calculated using cufflinks 2'; FN.p1 'FPKM values'); values are non-integer with tiny fractional values (e.g. 0.000256) and 39% integer only because of zeros. Isoforms (unversioned NM_/NR_) were summed per HGNC symbol (Cufflinks gene FPKM definition; MyGene.info mapping, 40184/43497 transcripts mapped, 21507 non-zero genes) by the listed prep script, because the paper analysed and reports gene symbols. The paper's input was FPKM too (S2.5.1.p1), so the matrix type agrees; FPKM is not count data, so DESeq2/edgeR are excluded.

selected.analysis_type: repeated-measures time series, analysed within each disease group (stratum grp), subject blocked; plus a between-group paired-change model for the disease x time interaction
selected.formula: ~ 0 + C(time) + C(subject) within each grp stratum

contrasts.name: post_vs_pre (mean d3,d7 minus mean d1,d2) per group
ME_vs_HC change from d1 at d2/d3/d7 (interaction)

decisions.reason: TAB3 compares days within each disease group (CFS, HC) and S3.3.p2 also asks whether the pre/post change differs between ME/CFS and controls. Day 1 is the only sample before any exercise (S2.5.p1: blood drawn before each CPET), so it is the reference. Subject is the repeated-measure unit. Disease is between-subject and nested with subject, so a single model with subject fixed effects and disease x time cells would be rank deficient; within-group fits (grp as stratum) give the paper's TAB3 contrasts, and the interaction is estimated on per-subject changes from day 1 (paired_change). ME/CFS-vs-control per-day contrasts and VO2/test-retest subsets are not exercise effects (subset labels are not in GEO) and are not run. Cohort is all female (S2.1.p1).

decisions.reason: Four samples per subject (S2.5.p1); subject is the blocking unit. Age/BMI matched by design (S3.1.p2); sex constant (female).

decisions.reason: FPKM is a linear normalized scale; limma on log2(FPKM+1) is the validated route for FPKM in the matrix-method policy. Subject is a fixed blocking effect.

selected.deviation_note: S2.5.1.p1 says 'fold change > +/-1.5, p < 0.05, FDR < 0.1%'. TAB4 lists DEGs with FDR 0.02-0.10, so the effective rule is FDR < 0.1; applied as BH padj < 0.1 and |log2FC| > log2(1.5) = 0.5849625. The raw p < 0.05 clause is implied in practice (padj >= p) and not applied separately. Audit rule = the literal 'FDR < 0.1%' (padj < 0.001) with the same fold change.

decisions.reason: Paper threshold kept on the limma deviation route; literal reading kept as audit.
